findings.explanation: HOL4 defines HD only by HD (h::t) = h. The clause goes through non_wfrec_defn (Defn.sml:1192) to Prim_rec.new_recursive_definition, which uses new_specification (Prim_rec.sml:281), with no ARB completion. A search of the HOL4 sources found no saved theorem giving HD [] a value. Lean adds the clause [] => ARB, so HD [] = ARB holds by rfl, and hence EL 0 [] = ARB. This identifies HD [] with the HOL4 constant ARB, and with other values Lean defines as ARB, e.g. HD ([] : List char) = CHR 256. HOL4 leaves these equations open.
findings.repair:
opaque HD_NIL (α : Type u) [Nonempty α] : α

def HD {α : Type u} [Nonempty α] : List α → α
  | h :: _ => h
  | [] => HD_NIL α
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Prelude.List

theorem HD_nil_eq_ARB {α : Type} [Nonempty α] : HD ([] : List α) = ARB := rfl

theorem EL_zero_nil_eq_ARB {α : Type} [Nonempty α] : EL 0 ([] : List α) = ARB := rfl
findings.hol4_check: ?hd:bool list -> bool. (!h t. hd (h::t) = h) /\ hd [] <> ARB
